Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat: create Big Ass Calendar generator with theming system

Implemented a Next.js application that generates and prints year-long calendars with the following features:

- Year-long calendar view with all 12 months in a single grid layout
- Weekend highlighting (Saturdays and Sundays)
- Bilingual support (English and Spanish) for day names and month labels
- 8 color themes: Classic Blue, Forest Green, Royal Purple, Bold Red, Sunset Orange, Pretty Pink, Ocean Teal, and Monochrome
- Customizable year and title
- Inter font for clean, professional typography
- Vertical month labels for space optimization
- Print-optimized CSS for large format printing (A1 landscape)
- Responsive grid with individual day cells for note-taking
- Day numbers in top-left corner (subtle styling)
- Day names centered in each cell

Tech stack:
- Next.js 16 with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4.x with @tailwindcss/postcss
- React 19
EOF
